manifest_row.title: How We Got Lost in the Wilderness | The Tyee

screening.main_topic: A review of a book examining Canadian wilderness mythology, environmental history, and Indigenous and colonial relationships with the land.
screening.climate_relevance: The article connects wilderness narratives and resource extraction to fossil fuel use and the climate crisis, and notes that adapting to climate change requires new ways of understanding nature. Climate change is a meaningful implication, but not the main focus.
screening.reason: The central subject is the cultural and historical construction of Canadian wilderness. Climate change appears in substantive connections to oil, the Trans Mountain pipeline, fossil fuel use, and adaptation, making the article relevant to broader climate discourse but not core climate coverage.
